verses.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.sm: Ua fetalai mai foi le ALI ia Mose, ua faapea mai,

verses.en: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, I am the LORD your God.
verses.sm: Ina fai atu ia i le fanauga a Isaraelu, ia faapea atu ia i latou, O au o le ALI lo outou Atua.

verses.en: After the doings of the land of Egypt, wherein ye dwelt, shall ye not do: and after the doings of the land of Canaan, whither I bring you, shall ye not do: neither shall ye walk in their ordinances.
verses.sm: O mea ua faia i le nuu o Aikupito, na outou mau ai, aua tou te faia faapea; O mea foi ua faia i le nuu o Kanana ou te faaoo atu ai outou, aua tou te faia faapea; aua neʻi usiusitai foi outou i a latou tu.

verses.en: Ye shall do my judgments, and keep mine ordinances, to walk therein: I am the LORD your God.
verses.sm: la outou faia aʻu faamasinoga, ia outou tausiusi foi i au tulafono, ina ia savavali i ai; o au o le ALII, o lo outou Atua.

verses.en: Ye shall therefore keep my statutes, and my judgments: which if a man do, he shall live in them: I am the LORD.
verses.sm: Ia outou tausiusi i aʻu tulafono ma aʻu faamasinoga; o mea ia, a faia e le tagata, e ola ai lava ia; o aʻu o le ALII.

verses.en: None of you shall approach to any that is near of kin to him, to uncover their nakedness: I am the LORD.
verses.sm: Aua neʻi faalatalata atu so outou i se tasi O lona lava aiga, e faatelenoa i lona tino; o aʻu o le ALII.

verses.en: The nakedness of thy father, or the nakedness of thy mother, shalt thou not uncover: she is thy mother; thou shalt not uncover her nakedness.
verses.sm: Aua e te faatelenoa i lou tamā po o lou tinā, o lou tinā lava ia, aua e te faatelenoa ia te ia.

verses.en: The nakedness of thy father's wife shalt thou not uncover: it is thy father's nakedness.
verses.sm: Aua e te faatelenoa i le aya a lou tamā, o le telenoa lea o lou tamā.

verses.en: The nakedness of thy sister, the daughter of thy father, or daughter of thy mother, whether she be born at home, or born abroad, even their nakedness thou shalt not uncover.
verses.sm: O lou tuafafine, o le afafine o lou tamā, po o le tama a lou tinā, sa fanau mai i le aiga, pe fanau mai i se tasi aiga, aua e te faatelenoa ia te ia.

verses.en: The nakedness of thy son's daughter, or of thy daughter's daughter, even their nakedness thou shalt not uncover: for their's is thine own nakedness.
verses.sm: O le afafine o lou atalii, po o le tama a lou afafine, aua e te faatelenoa ia te i laua; aua o lo la telenoa, o lou lava lea.

verses.en: The nakedness of thy father's wife's daughter, begotten of thy father, she is thy sister, thou shalt not uncover her nakedness.
verses.sm: O le tama tcine a le avā a lou tamā, o lou tama na fanau ai, o lou tuafafine lea, aua e te faatelenoa ia te ia.

verses.en: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy father's sister: she is thy father's near kinswoman.
verses.sm: Aua e te faatelenoa i le tuafafine o lou tama; o le aiga lava ia o lou tama.

verses.en: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy mother's sister: for she is thy mother's near kinswoman.
verses.sm: Aua e te faatelenoa i le uso o lou tina; o le aiga lava ia o lou tina.

verses.en: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy father's brother, thou shalt not approach to his wife: she is thine aunt.
verses.sm: Aua e te faatelenoa i le uso o lou tamā, aua e te faalatalata atu i lana ava; o le avā ia a le uso O lou tama.

verses.en: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy daughter in law: she is thy son's wife; thou shalt not uncover her nakedness.
verses.sm: Aua e te faatelenoa i le ava a lou atalii $ o le avā ia a lou atalii, aua e te faatelenoa ia te ia.

verses.en: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy brother's wife: it is thy brother's nakedness.
verses.sm: Aua e te faatelenoa i le avā a lou uso; o le telenoa lea o lou uso.

verses.en: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of a woman and her daughter, neither shalt thou take her son's daughter, or her daughter's daughter, to uncover her nakedness; for they are her near kinswomen: it is wickedness.
verses.sm: Aua e te faatelenoa i se fafine atoa ma lana tama teine; aua e te tago foi i le afafine o lana tama tane, po o le tama teine a lana tama teine e faatelenoa ia te ia; aua o fafine o lona lava aiga i latou; o le mea leaga lava lea,

verses.en: Neither shalt thou take a wife to her sister, to vex her, to uncover her nakedness, beside the other in her life time.
verses.sm: Aua foi e te fai ava i le uso O lau aya e faatiga ia te ia, e faatelenoa ia te ia atoa ma le tasi a o ola mai o ia.

verses.en: Also thou shalt not approach unto a woman to uncover her nakedness, as long as she is put apart for her uncleanness.
verses.sm: Aua foi e te faalatalata atu i se fafine e faatelenoa ia te ia, ina o nofo ese O ia ona o lona leaga.

verses.en: Moreover thou shalt not lie carnally with thy neighbour's wife, to defile thyself with her.
verses.sm: Ana foi neʻi momoe oulua ma le ava a le tasi, e leaga ai oe ia te ia.

verses.en: And thou shalt not let any of thy seed pass through the fire to Molech, neither shalt thou profane the name of thy God: I am the LORD.
verses.sm: Aua foi e te tuuina atu O so lau fanau e ui ane i le afi ia Moloka. Aua foi e te faaleagaina le igoa o lou Atua; o aʻu o le ALII.

verses.en: Thou shalt not lie with mankind, as with womankind: it is abomination.
verses.sm: Aua lua te momoe ma se tane, e pei ona momoe ma se fafine; o le mea e inosia lava lea.

verses.en: Neither shalt thou lie with any beast to defile thyself therewith: neither shall any woman stand before a beast to lie down thereto: it is confusion.
verses.sm: Aua foi lua te momoe ma se manu, e leaga ai oe ia te ia; aua neʻi tu atu foi se fafine i luma o se manu la te momoe ma ia; O le mea matua leaga lava lea.

verses.en: Defile not ye yourselves in any of these things: for in all these the nations are defiled which I cast out before you:
verses.sm: Aua lava neʻi leaga outou ia te outou i se tasi mea O ia mea; auá o mea uma lava ia ua leaga ai nuu ou te tulia i o outou luma.

verses.en: And the land is defiled: therefore I do visit the iniquity thereof upon it, and the land itself vomiteth out her inhabitants.
verses.sm: Ua leaga ai foi le laueleele; ou te taui atu ai le agasala ua i ai, e luai mai lava e le laueleele i e o nonofo ai.

verses.en: Ye shall therefore keep my statutes and my judgments, and shall not commit any of these abominations; neither any of your own nation, nor any stranger that sojourneth among you:
verses.sm: O lenei, ia outou tausiusi i aʻu tulafono ma aʻu faamasinoga; aua neʻi outou faia se mea e tasi o ia mea e inosia; o se tama a le eleele, po o se tagata ese e awtan ia te outou.

verses.en: (For all these abominations have the men of the land done, which were before you, and the land is defiled;)
verses.sm: Aua o mea e inosia uma ia ua faia e tagata O le nuu ua muai i ai ia te outou, ua leaga ai foi le laueleele;

verses.en: That the land spue not you out also, when ye defile it, as it spued out the nations that were before you.
verses.sm: ina neʻi luai mai e le laueleele ia te outou foi, pe a leaga ia te outou, e pei ona luai mai ai i nuu ua muai i ai ia te outou.

verses.en: For whosoever shall commit any of these abominations, even the souls that commit them shall be cut off from among their people.
verses.sm: Aua ai se na te faia se mea e tasi o ia mea e inosia, O tagata lava O e faia e vavaeeseina i latou i lo latou nuu.

verses.en: Therefore shall ye keep mine ordinance, that ye commit not any one of these abominable customs, which were committed before you, and that ye defile not yourselves therein: I am the LORD your God.
verses.sm: O lenei, ia outou tausiusi i a'u sauniga, ina ne'i faia e outou se mea e tasi o ia tu E inosia ua faia a O outou le i ai, ina neʻi leaga ai outou ia te outou; o aʻu o le ALII lo outou Atua.
